formats.description: Named directory of headerless mono unsigned eight-bit PCM effects.

roundtrip.scope: Directory and every PCM payload are preserved; rate is external playback metadata.

fields.notes: All 25 samples match the Windows WAV data chunks exactly. DOS requests 11000 Hz; Windows headers declare 11127 Hz. See docs/audio.md.
Case-unique identifiers map to extensionless Windows Sounds files; numeric IDs are one-based directory order.

formats.description: Named directory of complete XDIR/CAT XMIDI members.

roundtrip.scope: Outer directory, IFF headers/padding and opaque musical-event bytes are preserved.

fields.notes: 24 entries each contain one XMID sequence. No mapping from these entries to the eight CD selections is established.

formats.description: PCM RIFF/WAVE, including extensionless original Windows effects.

roundtrip.scope: RIFF header, all chunks, unknown metadata and original padding are retained exactly.

fields.notes: Size plus eight must equal the input. Microsoft RIFF documentation is linked in docs/audio.md.
Channels, rate, bit depth, byte rate and block alignment are checked together.
Ten original files omit final odd-data padding; this precise terminal variant is reported explicitly. Generated WAVs use standard padding.

formats.description: IFF XDIR sequence count and CAT XMID sequence framing.

roundtrip.scope: Every bounded IFF header, payload, group type and alignment byte is retained.

fields.notes: Lengths are relative to payload starts, bounded by the parent, and exclude even-byte alignment padding.
Must equal the number of FORM XMID children; all original members contain one.
Every observed TIMB length matches its count exactly. Instrument interpretation is deferred.
Event timing, notes, controllers and XMIDI loops are preserved without semantic decoding or MIDI conversion.

formats.description: Nine unframed words persisted by the original audio-settings routines.

roundtrip.scope: All nine words remain separate preservation regions.

fields.notes: Windows writer 0x0041E1B0 and reader 0x0041E2E0 agree with both 18-byte files; slot meanings remain unassigned.

formats.description: Single-BIN MODE1/2352 plus AUDIO CUE metadata; no payload validation.

roundtrip.scope: Geometry only; no CUE writer, BIN decoder, audio extraction or payload-authenticity claim.

fields.notes: Historical original CUE layout is documented in docs/audio.md. A complete BIN must be supplied again for fresh payload verification.

formats.description: dBASE-compatible table stream used directly and inside game sets.

roundtrip.scope: Header, field descriptors, records, terminator, and trailing bytes are preserved.

fields.notes: The declared count exactly bounds fixed-size rows in every supplied table.
Points immediately past the field-descriptor terminator.
Names, types, widths, decimal counts, and row offsets follow the dBASE descriptor layout.

formats.description: Named member directory shared by game sets and several resources.

roundtrip.scope: Directory bytes and every member payload are preserved in original order.

fields.notes: The count determines the number of named entries before the sentinel.
Eight-character identifiers occupy a nine-byte terminated slot.
Offsets are monotonic and the final sentinel equals file size.

formats.description: Numeric member directory used by text, language, and image resources.

roundtrip.scope: Directory bytes and every member payload are preserved in original order.

fields.notes: The count determines the number of members before the sentinel offset.
Offsets are monotonic and the final offset equals file size.

formats.description: Back-to-back size-framed indexed image records.

roundtrip.scope: Each size prefix, dimensions field, and pixel buffer is preserved.

fields.notes: Equals four dimension bytes plus width times height pixel bytes.
Dimensions exactly bound the following palette-index buffer.

formats.description: One uncompressed palette-indexed image without an outer directory.

roundtrip.scope: Dimensions and the complete palette-index buffer are preserved.

fields.notes: Width participates in the exact 4 + width*height length check.
Height participates in the exact 4 + width*height length check.
Lossless indexed-PNG exports reproduce the original images.

formats.description: Recognized input whose internal structure is not yet assigned.

roundtrip.scope: The complete byte stream is retained as one immutable opaque region.

fields.notes: No semantic interpretation is claimed; preservation is byte-for-byte.

formats.description: Named container whose members are complete dBASE streams.

roundtrip.scope: The outer directory and all embedded table streams are preserved exactly.

fields.notes: Every member in all supplied game sets passes strict dBASE framing.
Names identify the shipped economy tables without changing their order.

formats.description: Eight-byte header followed by 256 RGB triples.

roundtrip.scope: Both header words and all 768 color bytes are preserved.

fields.notes: Always equals the 776-byte file size in supported palettes.
The value is preserved but no meaning is assigned.
Channels are already in the 0..255 range and render decoded assets correctly.

formats.description: Fixed map core followed by zero or more city records.

roundtrip.scope: Header, grid, footer, and ordered city records are preserved.

fields.notes: Contains the internal path and display name in fixed slots.
Direct rendering reconstructs every supplied overview map and aligns with city coordinates.
Preserved without semantic names pending controlled map-editor experiments.
The fixed footer is preserved exactly; its fields remain undecoded.
Every coordinate lies in and aligns with the 240x198 map space.
Values resemble city populations, but a controlled editor experiment has not confirmed the meaning.

formats.description: Cross-platform version-100 save with metadata, settings, and 24 tagged sections.

roundtrip.scope: No writer is enabled; comparisons apply an explicit, versioned cross-build normalization policy.

fields.notes: DOS and Windows saves use the same record framing and fixed string/date locations.
Both executable readers and writers reference the same 24 tags in the same order.
The stored value matches the state of the recovered RNG implementation.
Values vary by runtime build and are discarded by the original loader; normalization zeros them.
Matched DOS and Windows saves differ by only 1..4 ULP; comparison reports rather than silently removes the drift.
Unassigned bytes are hashed and preserved; no original-format save writer is enabled.

formats.description: MZ wrapper containing either a PE32 or DOS4GW LE image.

roundtrip.scope: MZ/stub and new-format image regions are retained unchanged; executable editing is not supported.

fields.notes: Selects the PE or LE header when it lies within the file.
Fields follow the published PE layout and are bounds checked.
Object/page mappings reproduce known DOS file offsets.

formats.description: One-bit horizontal font sheet with cumulative glyph boundaries.

roundtrip.scope: Header, boundary table, and packed bitmap are preserved.

fields.notes: The range determines the exact number of cumulative boundary entries.
Geometry exactly bounds the packed bitmap.
MSB-first decoding reproduces all supplied glyph atlases.

formats.description: Offset-indexed 80x25 character/attribute screens.

roundtrip.scope: Offset directory and every character/attribute pair are preserved.

fields.notes: Decoded character rows reproduce the DOS text screen.
Foreground/background attributes retain exact original values.

formats.description: Offset-indexed supplemental palette glyph images.

roundtrip.scope: Offset directory, dimensions, and pixel bytes are preserved.

fields.notes: All supplied member dimensions exactly bound their pixel buffers.
Numeric order is retained; no language or character meaning is assigned.

formats.description: Sequential indexed image stream referenced by cursor metadata.

roundtrip.scope: Every image frame is preserved in source order.

fields.notes: Seven supplied images pass exact framing and render correctly.

formats.description: dBASE cursor metadata with binary image offsets.

roundtrip.scope: The complete dBASE stream, including binary pointer-field bytes, is preserved.

fields.notes: Values remain within the dimensions of the referenced images.
Every nonblank value resolves to an exact record boundary in I_CURSOR.RES.

formats.description: Named CP1252 help topics with ordered rectangular hotspots.

roundtrip.scope: Named directory and original topic bytes, line endings, and DOS EOF markers are preserved.

fields.notes: All supplied topics decode losslessly as CP1252 with ordered form-feed blocks.

fields.offset: first line of each form-feed block
fields.notes: The four values form non-reversed screen rectangles aligned with contextual help regions.

formats.description: Categorized 3x3 firm layout plans with stable item references.

roundtrip.scope: Category headers, raw 127-byte plan records, and 72-byte stable-reference records are preserved.

fields.notes: Reader/writer call boundaries confirm the header and 127-byte element size.
Nine ordered values align with the 3x3 plan grid and firm functional-unit identifiers.
Nine ordered values align with stable eight-byte item references.
The region is kept opaque because runtime-pointer handling is not yet fully proven.

formats.description: One size-compatible configuration record.

roundtrip.scope: Stored size prefix and physical payload are preserved, including version-tolerant tails.

fields.notes: The original reader expects 737 logical bytes and applies compatible-record rules.
Strings and offsets are reported without assigning configuration semantics.

formats.description: A 580-byte leaderboard record followed by a 13-byte save-name record.

roundtrip.scope: Both size prefixes and physical payloads are preserved exactly.

fields.notes: The 580-byte logical record divides evenly into ten observed leaderboard-sized slots.
The second compatible record contains the active internal save filename.
